title: LunaAI: A Polite and Fair Healthcare Guidance Chatbot

bias_targets.methodology: Heuristic expert evaluation using conversational transcripts and scripted probes to verify if the chatbot avoids making assumptions based on a user's age.
Heuristic expert evaluation utilizing checklists and conversation scenarios to assess whether the chatbot avoids making demographic assumptions based on a user's gender.

Scenario-based user testing (e.g., simulating complex cultural contexts like traditional herbal medicine) and expert heuristic evaluation to assess if the system respects and acknowledges diverse cultural health practices.

Heuristic evaluation checking whether the chatbot provides equitable access to information by offering multi-level information structuring to accommodate varying complexity preferences and health literacy levels.
